title: TEHRAN, Published Today, Nov 3rd, Iranian president Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks on talks with the U.S.
text:
TEHRAN, Published Today, Nov 3rd, Iranian president Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks on talks with the U.S."

"-------"

"SOT1, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:39): "The enemy’s current effort is to create division. They are making threats and inciting conflict, while we are striving to resolve the problem through dialogue. Our dear Leader has once again granted additional authority, [in addition to previous authorizations], so that discussions can take place on matters that he had previously said should not be discussed, enabling them to negotiate. They are taking actions, but ultimately this will result in a loss for no one, neither us, nor the region, nor the world, because no one will benefit from this war. It is not as if they can force our Iran into submission through quarreling and fighting.""

"SOT2, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:40 - 01:14): "They want to close the sea routes, land routes, and air routes and force us to surrender. As long as we stand together, we will not surrender. Of course, we do not want to fight. I have said many times that we are trying to engage in dialogue and resolve this; we must resolve it. But if they want to use force, it will not work that easily. They cannot simply use force against this nation and these people, given their history. We must join hands to counter this and help ensure that the problem is resolved.
